blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Forty percent of farmers are not listed in the government’s database for agricultural workers, Pampanga Rep. Anna York Bondoc said on Tuesday, urging them to register to qualify for government assistance amid rising fuel costs. Bondoc, who is defending the Department of Agriculture’s (DA) spending plan for next year, said that the Registry System for Basic Sectors in Agriculture (RSBSA) is underreported due to a lack of manpower to tally farmers and fisherfolk. “Not all farmers are covered or registered,” she told lawmakers at the House floor in Filipino. “In fact, a large 40 percent are not captured […]...
